explication: Concat is a cross-platform, local-first video editor with a native Rust engine, plus MCP and JSON-RPC interfaces for automation. The main user flow is to import footage, edit clips and tracks, preview the composition, and export a rendered video. Distinct branches provide captions, speech, background removal, titles, and effects. The graph combines README-documented capabilities with the sampled API and source-index references; most editor-to-engine wiring is unsampled, so those links are marked unverified rather than presented as observed calls.
